topic: The Physics of Refraction: Why Light Bends

sections.title: The Hook: The Broken Pencil Illusion
lecture_lines: Observe the pencil inside this glass of water.
It appears broken at the water's surface.
Light rays change direction between media.
animations: Create a Pencil object and a Glass object. Place pencil in water; show 'break' at surface. Label 'Pencil' (#FFFFFF) and 'Interface' (#FF0000).
Animate light rays from pencil underwater moving toward surface. Color: #FFFF00. Label 'Light Rays' (#FFFF00).
Animate rays bending at water surface interface within the glass. Color: #00FF00. Label 'Refraction' (#00FF00).

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Wave Nature of Light
lecture_lines: Light travels as a wave at speed v.
Materials affect speed based on density.
Think of a band entering thick mud.
animations: Display a propagating sine wave in medium 1 using as the wave boundary. Color: #00FFFF. Label 'Wavefronts' (#00FFFF).
Show wave entering denser medium, slowing down. Color: #FF00FF. Label 'Speed Change' (#FF00FF).
Animate wave path bending towards normal. Color: #FF0000. Label 'Path' (#FF0000).

sections.title: The Mechanism: Snell’s Law
lecture_lines: Refractive index defines how light slows.
Snell's law relates angles and indices.
Notice the normal line and angles.
Light bends when moving between media.
Adjust the angle to see refraction shift.
animations: Display Snell's Law: n1*sin(θ1) = n2*sin(θ2) in center (Row D). Color: #FFFFFF.
Animate incident ray hitting boundary. Label 'θ1' (Angle of Incidence) in #FFFF00.
Animate refracted ray bending. Label 'θ2' (Angle of Refraction) in #00FF00.
Show Normal line at boundary. Label 'Normal' (#FFFFFF).
Interactive slider to adjust θ1; see θ2 shift accordingly.

sections.title: Real-World Application: The Archer Fish
lecture_lines: The Archer Fish hunts above water.
Refraction shifts the appearance of prey.
The fish aims below the visible target.
animations: Draw Archer Fish under water aiming up. Label 'Archer Fish' (#FFA500).
Draw shifted target position due to refraction. Color: #FF0000. Label 'Shifted Target'.
Show fish firing jet towards true position, not visual target. Color: #0000FF. Label 'Water Jet'.

sections.title: Synthesis & Summary
lecture_lines: Refraction happens when light changes speed.
Entering dense media bends light toward normal.
Leaving dense media bends light away.
animations: Display Snell's Law: 'n1 sin θ1 = n2 sin θ2'. Flash for emphasis. Color: #FFFF00.
Briefly show Archer Fish diagram indicating successful hunt. Color: #00FF00. Label 'Application' (#00FF00).
